name: barclays-center
summary: Purpose-specific tournaments: officials before judges (a separate jailed process for executed code; plug-in officials in sibling repositories behind a file contract), advisory lens panels from a closed list of lanes, the existing controller for the bracket, one hash-chained and sealed verdict record.

exit_codes.1: invalid input, I/O or internal error
exit_codes.3: calibration ran; an expectation was not met

commands.validate <bout>: check a bout against its event card; runs nothing
commands.run <bout> --out <run> [--judges sim|rea: weigh-in, bracket, verdict, report, seal; --panel-from carries an imported panel for the same bytes into the verdict (advisory)
commands.resume <bout> --run <run>: after real judges answered the controller's packets: import, step, verdict
commands.panel-export <bout> --out <run> --pairs: weigh-in, then blind lens packets; --panel-lenses seats the organiser's choice of lenses for this bout (recorded in panel/roster.json and the verdict)
commands.panel-import <bout> --run <run> [--provi: validate reviewer results, enforce lens authority, reconcile orders
commands.verify <run> [--expect-head <hash>]: reports 'consistent' (chain, objects, sealed tree, re-derived eligibility) and 'authenticated' (the head equals the one given with --expect-head; null when none is given). Exit 2 if not consistent or if the head does not match
commands.calibrate <fixtures> --out <dir>: refuses unfrozen inputs; fixtures against frozen expectations, reseeding and position-bias probes, attack tables

global_options.--lenses <dir> (repeatable): lens card directories; a lens id defined twice is an error
global_options.--plugins <file>: plug-in table (schema barclays.plugins/0.1); also read from BARCLAYS_PLUGINS

authority.disqualify: a failure makes the candidate ineligible; unverified makes it incomplete
authority.advise: findings and leads only; never changes eligibility

acceptance: always pending_owner; Barclays recommends and never accepts, releases or publishes
invariants: A candidate that fails a decisive official is never recommended or shortlisted.
Unverified is neither a pass nor a failure. A harness failure is unverified; a candidate that exits or twice fails to answer in time has failed.
Leads and lens objections never change eligibility. A panel never changes a verdict's status or recommendation.

A factual objection from any reviewer is an allegation until verified. So is an objection filed under a word the venue does not know, one whose own words read as a claim about facts or the source, and an entry that names no candidate. Nothing a reviewer raised is dropped.
One reviewer's two display orders reconcile to one preference; a disagreement abstains.
A component not cleared for a bout's sensitivity label is refused before anything is written.
Bout inputs resolve inside the bout directory, and symbolic links are refused.

A bout may change only the parameters its event card lists under bout_may_set, and a number only where the card gives its own value; every such change is flagged, and a change to a decisive check requires a person.
Executed candidate code never shares a process with the tests that judge it.
A held-back suite reveals counts, never test names, inputs or expected values.

Run directories are written once; every object is content-addressed and chained; a finished run ends with a seal over every file, directory and link in it (a database by its schema and rows; permissions and timestamps are not sealed).
verify never reports a run as genuine without a head recorded outside the run: consistency and authentication are separate results.
An answer over the size limit, or a timeout while the candidate was not being waited on, is a failure only when another candidate's result shows the limit was reachable; otherwise it is unverified.
Lens lanes are a closed vocabulary matched exactly as written; only a fact desk holds a factual lane, and it holds nothing else.

A plug-in official's response is validated; anything missing, malformed, oversized or out of vocabulary is unverified, never pass. A pass carries no findings. A missing plug-in is flagged PLUGIN_MISSING.

A plug-in never receives an environment variable whose name contains KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or CREDENTIAL, nor the venue's own BARCLAYS_* settings, nor a scratch folder inside the run directory.
An officials_runnable event never names a recommended candidate.
A figure that is not in the source and is marked approximate is a major lead, not an accepted rounding; a finalist with a major lead requires a person.
The plug-in table is read once per run and that copy serves the whole run.
not_provided: an evidence store for the fleet
authentication of who wrote a run (record the ledger head outside the run and check it with verify --expect-head)
a hardened sandbox for hostile code (the jail is a namespace and a chroot on the host kernel; no process-count limit)
a decisive check for meaning changes that keep every surface form (those are leads and judges' work)
agreement of any judge route with human gold
evidence that a game is fun, a site is usable or a voice is the author's (human evidence only)
an operating-system sandbox around plug-ins or around the browser they drive
a signature on the plug-in table (it is recorded by hash)
detection of a panel reviewer who stays silent about a factual problem or words it as taste

tools.python tools/freeze.py [--check]: freeze every fixture directory and event card (fixtures/FROZEN.json); freeze, commit, then calibrate
tools.python tools/build_fixtures.py: rebuild fixtures and the software attack bout from fixtures/_pool
wrap one model answer in the controller's native result envelope; the model writes only its answer
tools.python tools/plugins_table.py [--family-: write the plug-in table from the sibling repositories found beside the venue (runs each sibling's `official.py list`)

flags.ATR:*: the controller's own flags, passed through
flags.BOUT_OVERRIDE:<target>.<param>: the bout changed a parameter its event card allows a bout to change
flags.EXEC_NOT_ISOLATED: candidate code ran without the jail on this host
flags.MODEL_GATE_EXCLUDED:<candidate>: a model gate inside the bracket excluded a candidate the weigh-in passed
flags.PANEL_PREFERRED_A_DISQUALIFIED_CANDIDATE: an attached panel preferred a candidate the weigh-in disqualified; it changed nothing
flags.SHADOW_SIM:JUDGES_ALONE_PREFERRED_A_DISQ: simulated judges with no weigh-in ranked a disqualified candidate first; says nothing about real models
flags.PLUGIN_MISSING:<official>: the event card names an official this venue has no plug-in for; it reported unverified
flags.PANEL_LENSES_CHOSEN_BY_ORGANISER: the attached panel's lenses were chosen for this bout, not taken from the event card
flags.PANEL_NO_FACT_DESK: no lens on the attached panel was briefed to check facts
flags.PLUGIN_TABLE_CHANGED_DURING_RUN: the plug-in table file changed while the officials ran; the run used the copy pinned at its start

event_status.officials_runnable: weigh-in and panel; no model bracket; the verdict names no winner and a human decides

family.barclays-lenses: lens cards bound to voice and review skills; cards load with --lenses
family.barclays-gold: blind human ballots; scores a judge route against human decisions from manifest.json and panel/panel.json
